national.title: Polisi Larang Demonstrasi Dekat Sekolah dan Kampus di Paris
national.summary: Kepolisian Paris melarang unjuk rasa dekat 10 sekolah dan 5 universitas akibat aksi blokade yang berlangsung dua bulan. Larangan berlaku Senin-Jumat.

national.title: Kampung Ambon Digerebek Lagi: 126 Personel Terjun, 5 Ditangkap
national.summary: Polisi menggerebek Kampung Ambon, Jakarta, menangkap lima pria positif narkoba. Operasi melibatkan 126 personel dan menyita barang bukti narkotika.

international.title: Megaspeed, the company linked to the downfall of Nvidia boss, says it’s a ‘legitimate and lawful business’
international.summary: Company insists Alice Huang, accused of being a Chinese spy, left business in late 2025 Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Megaspeed International, the company linked to the downfall of the Nvidia chief, Jensen Huang , says it is a “legitimate and lawful business” and has announced that its director, who allegedly had an affair with Huang, left the business in late 2025. The Singapore-based cloud computing company on the weekend said it was “aware of recent media reports containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence”.
